### EQ001 — Fizeau shift of the counter-circulating modes

*directional_frequency_shift*

$$
\Delta_F=\pm\frac{n r \Omega \omega_0}{c}\left(1-\frac{1}{n^2}-\frac{\lambda}{n}\frac{dn}{d\lambda}\right)\equiv\pm\eta\Omega
$$

status: `verified` · source: equation: Main Eq. (1); equation: Supplement Eqs. (S2)-(S3); tex_label: Sagnac, Sagnacshift

Numerical form:

```

```

*physical_model*

$$

$$
